Braised Pork Rice.note: Soy sauce = soy + wheat; Shaoxing = sulphites + gluten, not halal; pork; braised egg.

Taiwanese Beef Noodle Soup.note: Doubanjiang = soy + gluten; wheat noodles; Shaoxing = sulphites, not halal. Spicy. Suan cai = pickled greens, not mustard seed.

Clear Broth Beef Noodle Soup.note: Wheat noodles only. No soy sauce, no wine. Halal by ingredients.

Oyster Mee Sua.note: Mee sua = wheat; oysters; bonito = fish; pork intestine.

Three Cup Chicken Rice.note: Sesame oil; soy sauce; Shaoxing wine (not halal). Mild.

Mushroom Lu Rou Fan.note: Tofu, soy sauce; braised egg so not vegan.

Sesame Cold Noodles.note: Wheat, sesame paste, peanut butter, soy sauce. Mildly spicy.

Popcorn Chicken.note: Soy sauce; Shaoxing wine (not halal). Sweet potato starch is gluten-free but soy sauce is not.

Giant Fried Chicken Cutlet.note: Soy sauce = soy + wheat. No wine listed.

Scallion Pancake.note: Sounds vegetarian but made with pork lard. Wheat; egg; soy paste.

Pork Belly Gua Bao.note: Milk bun = wheat + milk; soy; peanut powder; pork.

Fried Chicken Gua Bao.note: Milk bun; soy; mayo = egg; peanuts.

Mushroom Gua Bao.note: Wheat bun without milk; soy; peanut powder. King oyster mushroom is not a mollusc.

Stinky Tofu.note: Sounds vegetarian but the brine has dried shrimp = crustaceans. Tofu, soy sauce. Spicy.

Oyster Omelette.note: Oysters; egg; miso and soy sauce = soy (+ wheat in soy sauce).

Spicy Wontons in Chilli Oil.note: Wheat wrapper; prawn; soy sauce; sesame seeds; pork. Very spicy.

Taiwanese Sausage.note: Pork and liquor, not halal. Soy sauce. Kaoliang (sorghum) adds no gluten or sulphites by the rules.

Crispy Squid.note: Squid = molluscs. Sweet potato starch, no wheat, no soy.

Mango Shaved Ice.note: Milk ice, condensed milk; ice cream with egg.

Taro Ball Shaved Ice.note: No listed allergens. Taro/tapioca balls, no wheat.

Peanut Ice Cream Roll.note: Ice cream = milk; peanut brittle; wheat crepe. No egg listed.

Pineapple Cake.note: Wheat pastry; butter, milk powder; egg.

Classic Pearl Milk Tea.note: 'Non-dairy' creamer contains milk protein (casein) = milk. Not vegan. Caffeine.

Winter Melon Tea.note: Winter melon infusion, no tea leaves: caffeine-free.

Taro Oat Milk Tea.note: Oats = gluten (EU cereal rule). Dairy-free. Caffeine (green tea).

Taiwan Beer.note: Beer = barley = gluten; alcohol, not halal. No animal products.
